meta.source: Swapmeet visual mood board — Bright Retro Marketplace v2

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Warm Cream — the brand's base paper, a soft warm off-white. Identity swatch; the light page ground (see bg).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Ink — near-black brand color in Day; lightened to a cool teal-gray in Night so it stays legible (4.75:1 on panel). Text on light grounds; a panel fill paired with on-ink.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Deep Teal — the primary brand color. Identity swatch; carries the product alongside Cream and Ink. White text reads ~5:1.

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: Leaf Green — secondary brand, for sustainability and local. Identity swatch; white text reads AA.

tokens.name: marigold
tokens.usage: Marigold — warm accent for highlights and tags. Identity swatch; always pair with Ink text, never white.

tokens.name: tomato
tokens.usage: Tomato — hot accent for bidding and promotions. Identity swatch; a FILL for large labels, graphics and blocks, not small white-text buttons (~3.9:1).

tokens.name: denim
tokens.usage: Denim Blue — secondary accent for categories and informational UI. Identity swatch; white text reads AA.

tokens.name: raspberry
tokens.usage: Raspberry — playful accent for livestream, social and community. Identity swatch; a large FILL, not small white-text buttons.

tokens.name: oat
tokens.usage: Oat — warm surface neutral for cards and filters. Identity swatch; Ink text reads excellent (see panel).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Danger Red — semantic error and deletion only. Deliberately kept apart from Tomato so warnings never blur with promotion. White text reads ~9:1.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Ink / text reads well on it in both themes.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised surface for cards, tables and inputs. Ink / text on it clears 4.5:1 in both themes; separate from bg by its line border and shadow-card.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Recessed panel for filters, note blocks and table heads. Ink / text on it clears 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and nav on bg, surface and panel. Clears 4.5:1 on all three in both themes.

tokens.name: text-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text — metadata, captions, help. On bg and surface only; clears 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and quiet borders between cells and cards. Non-text; decorative separation.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Structural 2.5px outlines and tertiary-button borders. Clears 3:1 as a meaningful border in both themes.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary brand role — links, focus ring, primary emphasis. Pair with on-primary text on solid fills.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary brand role — sustainability and local UI. Pair with on-secondary text on solid fills.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Warm accent role — highlights, tags, secondary buttons. Always Ink text (on-accent), never white.

tokens.name: hot
tokens.usage: Hot accent role — bidding and promotion. Large fills and graphics; pair with text or icon, not small white-text buttons.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational role — categories and neutral status. Pair with on-info text on solid fills.

tokens.name: play
tokens.usage: Playful role — livestream, social, community. Large fills; pair with text or icon.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on Deep Teal primary fills. White; reads ~5:1 on #087f8c.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on Leaf secondary fills. White; reads AA.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on Marigold and Oat. Ink, never white — white on Marigold fails.

tokens.name: on-info
tokens.usage: Text and icons on Denim fills. White; reads AA.

tokens.name: on-hot
tokens.usage: Text on Tomato — large text (24px+/bold 19px+) and graphics only; do not use for small labels.

tokens.name: on-play
tokens.usage: Text on Raspberry — large text and graphics only; always with an icon or word too.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on Danger Red fills. White; reads ~9:1.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on Ink fills — cream in Day (on near-black Ink), ink-dark in Night (on the lightened Ink). Follows Ink; reads ~14:1 Day, ~5.5:1 Night.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero H1, 48–64px. Archivo at SemiCondensed width (~87%) — set font-stretch:87% in code.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: UI labels and eyebrows, 14–16px. Set uppercase in code.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Metadata — distance, rating, seller. Use text-soft.

spacing.note: Derived from the values the mood board composes with (16px gutter, 12–16px gaps); a regular 4px scale, not an explicit source table.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps, icon-to-label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside chips, badges, meta rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Grid gaps between cards and controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default card padding and page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Roomier card and panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Block spacing inside sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between content groups.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section rhythm, top of hero.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls, swatches, inline chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Default radius — cards, buttons, inputs, tables.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large surfaces such as the AI panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills — filters, tags, badges, toggles.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The one elevation — cards, panels, popovers, toggles. Pair with a line border; shape carries more weight than shadow.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Structural outline width — card frames, tertiary buttons, table borders, focus. Use with line-strong.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Quiet inner dividers between rows and cells. Use with line.
